title: Associations between prenatal exposure to micro(nano)plastics and neonatal lipid profile
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,925-937
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00898K, Paper
Xuan Song, Ouyang Chen, Fan Rao, Chunmei Wang, Lixia Du, Jing Wu, Wei Guo, Li Yang, Li Li, Lingli Zeng, Chuan Yuan, Yong Liu, Xiaoqian Feng
Micro(nano)plastics (MNPs) absorbed by the mother can be transferred to newborns and may subsequently affect lipid metabolism in offspring.
